header.title: Contact & Dispatch
header.subtitle: Talk to the local dispatch team in Santa Cristina. Call, WhatsApp or email — for the fastest answer during a journey, WhatsApp works best.

hours.title: Dispatch hours
hours.body: 24-hour dispatch during the winter and summer high season. Outside high season, call or WhatsApp and dispatch will confirm availability.

map.title: Map
map.note: Map position approximate — to be confirmed.

howToFind.title: How to find us
howToFind.body: The office sits on the main road through Santa Cristina Val Gardena, between Ortisei (St. Ulrich) and Selva (Wolkenstein). Ponte Gardena rail station is about 18 km down the valley; Bolzano airport is around 40 km via the Val Gardena road and the A22 Brenner motorway.

cta.title: Need a taxi now?
cta.body: For an on-demand ride, call the direct dispatch line or send a WhatsApp with your pickup point and number of passengers.

whatsappMessage: Hello Taxi Auto Sella, I would like to request a taxi transfer.
